user.title: Connect to an OpenTelemetry collector
user.description: Point Home Assistant at an OTLP endpoint (such as SignalDB, an OpenTelemetry Collector, Grafana Tempo/Loki/Mimir, or any OTLP-compatible backend).

data.endpoint: OTLP endpoint (host:port for gRPC, or a base URL for HTTP)

reconfigure.title: Edit the OpenTelemetry collector connection
reconfigure.description: Update where Home Assistant sends telemetry. Existing exporters reload with the new settings.

data.endpoint: OTLP endpoint (host:port for gRPC, or a base URL for HTTP)

abort.already_configured: This endpoint and tenant are already configured

data.enable_process_metrics: Include process metrics (Home Assistant's own CPU, memory, threads, GC)
data.enable_host_metrics: Include host metrics (machine/container CPU, memory, swap, disk, network)
data.scope_system: Include system-level telemetry (service calls, automations, entity/integration health, event throughput)
data.scope_entities: Include per-entity telemetry (entity state as metrics)
data.enable_state_changed_traces: Also emit a trace span per entity state change (high volume; off by default)
data.include_domains: Only include these entity domains for per-entity telemetry (comma-separated, empty = all)
